pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 69 degrees, relative humidity 52 percent, barometer 29.99 inches,
adjusted altitude 2,252 feet, track temperature 102 degrees.

Langdon is 7 - 4 against Torrence in prior events. 

Langdon with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Langdon with his second
quickest pass of the weekend for the win.  He is advancing to his 12th final this season and 63rd of
his career.

Torrence with good pass in the losing effort.

Kalitta is 27 - 13 against Pruett in prior events. 

Doug Kalitta is 6 - 1 against Pruett in semi-final rounds.
In their 40 rounds Doug has "left first" 29 times.

Pruett with a slight starting line advantage, but Kalitta had the lead as they went by the Christmas
tree and never trailed from there on for the win.  Kalitta ties the quickest pass of the event and
the fastest pass in the history of Pomona.  He is advancing to his 10th final this season and 126th
career final round.
